### Problem description

A clear and concise description of what the problem is or what limitation you are facing (e.g. "I'm having trouble with...").

### What needs to be done?

Describe the proposed changes or feature to be added to the software.

### Benefit

Describe the benefit that the changes to the software create and why this is valuable to users.

### Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions, features, or workarounds you've considered.

### Acceptance criteria

Describe criteria which a pull request has to meet to complete this issue.

- [ ] Criteria A
- [ ] Criteria B
- [ ] Criteria C

### Remarks

Space to leave additional remarks, mockups, or screenshots if needed. If not needed, simply write "--".
